names.name: Cider donut season
names.said: September to the first hard frost, and then the machine goes quiet.

text.what: The weeks when orchards and cider mills in the Northeast and Midwest run donut machines for the people who came to pick apples.
text.story:
Cider donut season runs with the apple harvest: September through November or December. Grocery stores put them out as early as August. Food & Wine has pointed out that a year-round cider donut is unlikely to contain fresh-pressed cider.

Donuts were autumn food long before this: the slaughter season produced the surplus fat to fry them in.
text.today: Leaf-peeping traffic and the donut window are the same business for six weeks a year.

kin.as: Whose machine made it a roadside trade.
